diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
aws_autoscaling_group.ng already depends implicitly on aws_launch_template.ng through mixed_instances_policy.launch_template, so the explicit depends_on entry for the launch template is redundant.
aws_eks_node_group.ng already references aws_iam_role.ng through node_role_arn, so the explicit depends_on entry for the IAM role is redundant.

When App Mesh/X-Ray is enabled, aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write attaches the X-Ray permissions to the node role, but aws_autoscaling_group.ng can launch instances before that attachment completes. It should be ordered with the other node role policy attachments.

When App Mesh/X-Ray is enabled, aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write attaches the X-Ray permissions to the node role, but aws_eks_node_group.ng can create nodes before that attachment completes. It should be ordered with the other node role policy attachments.

module.alb-ingress's helm_release.albingress references only the IRSA role ARN output; that output does not depend on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa, so the controller can start before its IAM policies are attached. The release should be ordered after the policy attachment.
